info.title: Tuition Media API
info.description:
Backend for Tuition Media. Every path is under `/api/v1`. Send the access token from `POST /api/v1/auth/google` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Errors share one body (`ErrorResponse`); match on `code`.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error code. Match on this.

details.description: Ids related to the error. Omitted on masked 5xx responses.

issues.description: One entry per zod issue. Sent only with VALIDATION_ERROR.

get.description:
Returns 503 with status degraded when the database does not answer.

**Who:** Public.

**Rate limit:** global 100/min.

500.description: Unexpected error. In production the message is masked

post.summary: Sign in or sign up with Google
post.description:
Verifies the Google ID token. Sign-up sends role (and optionally consentVersion); sign-in omits role. An unknown Google account with no role gets 404. A blocked account, or a deleted account signing in without a role, gets 403. Returns an access token and a refresh token.

**Who:** Public.

**Rate limit:** global 100/min.

400.description: Validation failed (VALIDATION_ERROR with `issues`) or the request breaks a business rule

403.description: The account's role cannot call this route

500.description: Unexpected error. In production the message is masked

post.description:
Revokes the old refresh token and returns a new access token and refresh token. Returns 401 UNAUTHORIZED when the token is unknown, revoked or expired, or the account is not ACTIVE.

**Who:** Public.

APPROVE raises the tutor's zone limit to approvedLimit (default: the requested limit). A grant never lowers an existing limit. 409 ZONE_REQUEST_DECIDED when the request is no longer PENDING.

**Who:** ADMIN with an ACTIVE admin_user row.

**Rate limit:** 60/min per account.
